claims.evidence: Witness could not read the camera body's model text in any photo; only the 'Nikon' logo is visible.
Photo 1 shows lens barrel text 'Nikon AF-P DX Nikkor 70-300mm 1:4.5-6.3G ED'.

claims.claim: working perfectly ok with no fault
claims.evidence: No power-on, shutter-fire, autofocus, or LCD display shot/clip provided; still photos cannot show functionality.
Photo 2 shows visible wear, scuffing and texture loss on the hand-grip.

risks.risk: Camera body may not actually be a D3400 (or may be a different/lower sub-model)
risks.proof: Clear photo of the model label on the base plate or the camera's info/setup menu screen showing model name
risks.if_unproven: priced as unconfirmed generic entry-level Nikon DSLR body, not guaranteed D3400

risks.risk: Core functionality (shutter, autofocus, LCD, dials) unverified
risks.proof: Short video: power on, menu navigation, shutter fire, AF lens racking, image review on LCD
risks.if_unproven: priced as untested/as-is, risk of non-working unit

risks.risk: Lens glass condition (haze, fungus, scratches) unknown
risks.proof: Photo of lens held up to bright light from front and rear elements
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic-only verified, optical defects assumed possible

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, memory card, lens cap, strap already seen)
risks.proof: Photo laying out all included items/accessories
risks.if_unproven: priced as body+lens only, no extras included

risks.risk: High shutter actuation count or sensor dust/scratches
risks.proof: Screenshot from shutter-count checking software or a test photo at small aperture (f/16+) against plain sky showing sensor spots
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown-usage, worst-case high-mileage sensor

proof_requests: Clear photo of camera base plate model/serial sticker or menu screen showing exact model
Short video of camera powering on, shutter firing, autofocus racking, and LCD review
Photo of lens front and rear elements against bright light
Photo of all included accessories (battery, charger, card, cap)
Shutter count screenshot or sample high-aperture test photo for sensor dust check
response.reason: The witness confirms a Nikon DSLR body with a Nikon 70-300mm zoom lens showing visible wear, which is enough to price at worst case; the exact body model, functionality, lens optics, and accessories remain unverified and should be priced conservatively until proven.
